## Context
The corrected #161 model (OB entry `d765c029`, namespace open-brain) defines server-adjudicated promotion in three pieces:
- (a) worthiness classifier — **shipped** in #161
- (b) dedup (exact content_hash + near-embedding `<=> < 0.08`) — **shipped** in #161
- (c) **thought-cluster supplementation — UNBUILT, this issue**

## What (c) is
When a nominated lane memory relates to an existing shared-kb *thought cluster*, the promoter should SUPPLEMENT/LINK it into that cluster via the entity graph rather than (i) skipping it as a near-dup or (ii) adding a standalone row. Enrichment, not correctness — dedup already prevents duplicate noise in the interim.

## Scope to design
- Cluster detection (similarity band between "exact dup" `< 0.08` and "unrelated").
- Merge-vs-link policy: when to append to an existing cluster entity vs create a new edge.
- Entity-graph write shape + provenance.
- Dry-run preservation (DreamEngine rule: no mutation from planning).
- Live-DB tests (mock pools don't catch SQL — see docs/sme/correctness.md).

## Prereqs
- #161 merged (provides the adjudication + promoter-gated write path).
- get_contract help (#172) if agents need to influence clustering.
